summary: Iteration 27 - Membership Expiration Edit Feature Testing Complete. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Members table shows 'Vencimiento' column with colored dates (green for future, red for expired), clicking a date opens 'Modificar Vencimiento' modal with date input and comment textarea, saving updates the expiration date successfully. The existing 'Asignar Membresía' modal in the dropdown menu still works correctly (no conflict with the new edit expiration modal).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing members with memberships for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 tested the membership expiration edit feature. Backend: PUT /api/members/{member_id}/membership endpoint accepts end_date (required) and comment (optional), returns 200 on success, 400 if no end_date, 404 if member not found or has no membership. The endpoint also updates membership status based on date (active for future, expired for past). Frontend: AdminMembers.js has two separate modals - showMembershipModal for 'Asignar Membresía' (line 92) and showEditExpirationModal for 'Modificar Vencimiento' (line 124). Clicking a date in the Vencimiento column opens the edit modal. The handleUpdateMembership function (line 370) calls updateMemberMembership API. All data-testid attributes are in place: membership-date-input, membership-comment-input, membership-save-btn, edit-membership-{member_id}.

backend_update_membership_success.details: Successfully updates membership expiration date with optional comment. Returns {success: true, message: 'Vencimiento actualizado a {date}'}

backend_update_membership_without_commen.details: Works without comment field - only end_date is required

backend_update_membership_missing_end_da.details: Returns 400 with 'Fecha de vencimiento requerida' when end_date is missing

backend_update_membership_nonexistent_me.details: Returns 404 with 'Socio no encontrado' for non-existent member

backend_update_membership_no_membership.details: Returns 404 with 'No se encontro membresia activa para este socio' when member has no membership

backend_update_membership_status_based_o.details: Sets membership status to 'active' for future dates, 'expired' for past dates

backend_unauthenticated_request_fails.details: Returns 401/403 for requests without auth token

frontend_vencimiento_column_display.details: Members table shows 'Vencimiento' column header. Dates are displayed with color coding: green (bg-emerald-900) for future dates, red (bg-red-900) for expired, yellow (bg-yellow-900) for expiring soon.

frontend_date_clickable.details: Date badges have cursor-pointer class and data-testid='edit-membership-{member_id}'. Clicking opens the edit modal.

frontend_edit_expiration_modal.details: Modal titled 'Modificar Vencimiento' opens with member info, date input (data-testid='membership-date-input'), comment textarea (data-testid='membership-comment-input'), and save button (data-testid='membership-save-btn').

frontend_save_expiration_update.details: Clicking 'Guardar Cambio' calls updateMemberMembership API, shows success toast 'Vencimiento actualizado', and refreshes the members list.

frontend_assign_membership_modal_no_conf.details: The existing 'Asignar Membresía' modal (showMembershipModal) in the dropdown menu still works correctly. No conflict with the new edit expiration modal (showEditExpirationModal).
